cases.title: Local image provisions supervised Tiled 0.2.19
cases.expected_rule: no sidecar requirement; persistent local state

cases.title: ALS images never run or provision a managed Tiled server
cases.expected_rule: no fallback server on central outage

cases.title: Staging and production default to their exact assigned endpoints
cases.expected_rule: reject unapproved environment/target mismatch

cases.title: Every UI asset and deep link is served beneath /fair2wise
cases.expected_rule: no compiled localhost API, lost path or SPA fallback for missing assets

cases.title: Legacy API suffixes work behind one prefix-stripping boundary
cases.expected_rule: settings/chat/graph/session schemas and response statuses unchanged

cases.title: OpenAPI redirects and model-compatible routes have correct prefixes
cases.expected_rule: no duplicate root_path or UI API/model API collision

cases.title: SSE works through container and edge proxy
cases.expected_rule: first progress and one terminal event; cancellation/errors preserved

cases.title: No private papers or secrets occur in any image layer/build cache
cases.expected_rule: inspect intermediate layers, not just final image filesystem

cases.title: Private mounts remain unserved and survive restart/recreate
cases.expected_rule: source/crops/state do not fall back to ephemeral image directories

cases.title: Admin importer enforces reviewed target and literature scope
cases.expected_rule: browser/model cannot choose arbitrary URL/namespace or mutate FORGE sentinels

cases.title: Audit distinguishes requester approver and executing admin
cases.expected_rule: Local audit identifies local-operator without invented authenticated human identity; ALS uses verified subjects. executed_as is separate configured admin in both modes; no tokens leak.

cases.title: JSON creation succeeds without Tiled and import is inference-free
cases.expected_rule: build/pull/start never automatically publishes a corpus

cases.title: Import receipts cannot cross local staging production targets
cases.expected_rule: same JSON hash requires target-specific plan and receipt

cases.title: CI publication is trusted and prod promotion follows approved policy
cases.expected_rule: PRs cannot publish tags or access runtime keys

cases.title: Ansible deploys tested digest without image FQDN dependencies
cases.expected_rule: prefix-preserving edge, runtime mounts/secrets, no central reset

cases.title: Mounted-state consistent backup restores on a new disposable instance
cases.expected_rule: JSON/receipts/jobs/artifacts/local Tiled recover; central backup ownership documented

cases.title: Process death termination and job drain preserve durable work
cases.expected_rule: no idle successful container concealing dead API/worker/Tiled

cases.title: Profile-specific access preserves truthful old-UI behavior
cases.expected_rule: D34: local full functionality without sign-in. D30: ALS Tiled-admin editing and non-admin denial. No fake Save, lost edit, hidden publication or local-to-ALS access bypass.

cases.title: Configured model and limits survive deployment profile changes
cases.expected_rule: no forced model/default paid escalation; unsupported local network/inference explicit

cases.title: Image and data rollback remain independent
cases.expected_rule: old digest/state compatibility and snapshot reactivation are separately validated

cases.title: Base-path build/runtime mismatch is diagnosed
cases.expected_rule: no attempt to fix immutable Vite build solely with runtime ENV

cases.title: ALS: Unauthenticated requests cannot chat or invoke jobs
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Only login shell and non-sensitive health allowed; no model call or data effect before verified login.

cases.title: ALS: Native Tiled non-admin chat succeeds
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Allowed chat/session/model preference and authorized read evidence work without graph writes.

cases.title: ALS: Non-admin ingestion and batch work are denied
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Reject before job creation, downloads, extraction, model budget reservation or candidate mutation.

cases.title: ALS: Non-admin graph edit and approval are denied
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Legacy routes, direct SDK, Tools and workers cannot bypass admin check.

cases.title: ALS: Admin scoped edit and import succeed with audit
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: requested_by/approved_by are verified user subjects; executed_as is separate writer; IDs/readback preserved.

cases.title: ALS: Forged roles and writer identity do not elevate user
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Ignore caller-declared is_admin, spoofed headers or writer account role in user resolution.

cases.title: ALS: Expiry, logout, role downgrade and revocation block new effects
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Revalidate privileged authorization; fail closed without losing prior audit history.

cases.title: ALS: Identity and publication grants are environment-bound
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Staging subject/token/receipt does not authorize production; no implicit alternate-server validation.

cases.title: ALS: prefixed native Tiled sign-in works
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: usable /fair2wise sign-in/return path with no broad unauthenticated Tiled admin proxy or credential leakage. Local no-login behavior is covered by LOCAL cases.

cases.title: ALS: FORGE delegation preserves caller capability
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Non-admin request inside admin-capable host cannot trigger ingestion/publication or expose full papers.

cases.title: ALS: Ordinary chat recording is not a Tiled write bypass
cases.expected_rule: ALS only: Session/audit bookkeeping is not silently published using the service admin key.

cases.title: Committed JSON equals validated graph bytes
cases.expected_rule: Commit/path/sha256 and staging PASS result identify identical snapshot/manifest; mutation forces new validation.

cases.title: Production promotion invokes zero extraction or inference
cases.expected_rule: Transfer/export/import approved Git JSON without parser/model/acquisition/canonicalization calls.

cases.title: Production import has independent authorization and receipt
cases.expected_rule: Staging receipt/approval cannot substitute for target-scoped production admin plan.

cases.title: Git commit candidates exclude private source and secrets
cases.expected_rule: Check tracked graph/manifests without exposing full papers, crops, raw source bodies or credentials.

cases.title: Tracked graph snapshots remain outside image layers
cases.expected_rule: All three variants exclude Git-tracked corpus data from build context/final and intermediate layers.

cases.title: Private evidence dependencies are checked without hidden rebuild
cases.expected_rule: Missing private asset yields explicit blocked/degraded capability rather than model calls or source commit.

cases.title: Admin edits produce a new committed promotion version
cases.expected_rule: Reconcile journal into new JSON, preserve previous version; older import cannot erase acknowledged edits.

cases.title: Data rollback and code rollback are independent
cases.expected_rule: Select an earlier immutable data commit/hash with target approval, no history rewrite or automatic image coupling.

cases.title: FORGE merge status is independently recorded
cases.expected_rule: A tested patch is not reported merged; owner/Alex select target and authorize remote integration.

cases.title: Local application opens fully without sign-in
cases.expected_rule: With no Tiled user account/session/token, /fair2wise opens without login redirect; all application controls are available. Repeat with expired and non-admin user credentials without restricting local capabilities.

cases.title: All local administrative workflows are callable without login
cases.expected_rule: Without user sign-in, run literature discovery/intake/extraction/figure processing, Knowledge Operations, curation, explicit approval, versioned JSON creation, local Tiled publication and graph editing using isolated fixtures. All preserve their scientific/data contracts.

cases.title: Local audit records operator rather than invented authentication
cases.expected_rule: Use deployment_profile=local and authorization_mode=local_trusted. requested_by=local-operator; approved_by becomes local-operator only after explicit approval. No authenticated user subject or role-check timestamp is fabricated; executed_as is the separate configured writer.

cases.title: Local API SDK Tools and workers use the same access policy
cases.expected_rule: No user login is required for local direct Python/CLI, FastAPI, agent Tools or scoped background resume; work stays within the recorded local target/effects and respects cancellation and explicit approvals.

cases.title: Local user identity lookup is not an access prerequisite
cases.expected_rule: Disable or mock user-identity/admin lookup as unavailable while preserving the local Tiled graph service. Local application capabilities and publication still work through service credentials, with zero user-role gate calls.

cases.title: Backend service failure is not a user login challenge
cases.expected_rule: Missing/invalid local Tiled service credentials produce a truthful graph-operation failure, not a request for user sign-in. Unrelated local QA/JSON capabilities stay available; credentials are not returned to the browser.

cases.title: Trusted access cannot be selected through an ALS request
cases.expected_rule: On als-dev and als-prod, client/header/model/payload claims of local_trusted, a local hostname or a saved local grant do not authorize privileged calls. Identity outages fail closed; ALS rejects local_trusted startup overrides.

cases.title: Local exposure defaults to loopback
cases.expected_rule: The local launcher host bind defaults to 127.0.0.1 or equivalent loopback. Wider exposure requires explicit operator configuration and communicates that every reachable user has full application access.

cases.title: Local full access does not disable scientific or source rules
cases.expected_rule: No-login local operation still enforces schema/evidence validation, immutable JSON versions, target-specific import checks, rate limits, explicit approval and private full-paper/crop handling. The agent cannot fabricate owner H-gate approval.

cases.title: Local approvals do not authorize central publication
cases.expected_rule: A local job/ApprovalRecord/receipt cannot authorize staging or production import. Receiving ALS deployment checks its own profile, verified admin and target scope before invoking its configured writer.
